profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a public company headquartered in Miami, Florida, that trades under the ticker HUT. On its own site the company describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies, and says this portfolio gives direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also reports that Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Beacon Point AI Data Center Campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion. The company's recorded litigation exposure is in Florida, where 96 cases are noted. No individual products or MCP servers are tracked for the company.
